name: cc-preview
description: Preview images and markdown files from the conversation and the prompt: hover cards, and a side pane that draws markdown as a preview does (tables, tasks, alerts, math, pictures)

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: How pictures are drawn. graphics (default): kitty graphics. blocks: colored block characters, which every terminal and mosh carry. auto: choose from TERM_PROGRAM, TERM and CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES at startup, without process scans. Use blocks for mosh; g switches modes in the pane.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LC_ALL / LANG, else English.
